author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: प्रशान्तात्मा स्वतो विषयेषु अप्रवृत्तमनस्कः विगतभीः व्याघ्रचोरादिभयहीनः ब्रह्मचारिव्रते स्थितः मनः सम्यक् प्रत्याहृत्य मच्चित्तो मद्ध्यानवान्मत्परः अहमेव परः सर्वोत्तमः यस्य स मत्परः युक्तः समाधिसंपन्न आसीतेत्यर्थः ॥ ६.१४॥
translation:
With the mind perfectly tranquil, without fear being firm in the vow of the Brahmachârin, having restrained the mind, thinking of Myself, thinking that I am the Supreme, he should remain meditating on Me. (14)
V. The verse 13 which is not a complete sentence may be construed with the foregoing or the following verse,
With...... tranquil: with the mind which by habitual control has even without the effort of the self ceased to run to the objects. Without fear: fearless of any danger from wild animals or wicked men, &c .  (13-14).
A. The fruit of Samadhi or meditation is given here
